BondCore.boundary: Internal bookkeeping with executable non-reentrant dependency models and a fixed 3:2 conversion; not Accounting authorization, collateral adequacy, or rebases.

BondLock.boundary: Internal lock transitions, expiry and modulo nonce semantics; callers' authorization and penalty settlement integration are outside this harness.

FeeSplits.boundary: Split arithmetic, configuration guards and pending-share bookkeeping within the production maximum split length; not actual Accounting transfers.

FeeDistributor.boundary: Actual reward distribution and access checks with a non-reentrant exact-share token model, one-sibling real Merkle proofs and bounded strings; not arbitrary Merkle depth or oracle correctness.

DepositAllocator.boundary: Exactly two allocation operators, normalized positive X96 shares and bounded scalar amounts; standalone quantization/packing and small heap checks; not global fairness or arbitrary operator counts.
